title: Mediation Act, 2023 — Section 6 (Disputes not fit for mediation)

content.overview: Section 6 lists disputes that are not fit for mediation, including disputes expressly barred and those affecting rights of third parties who are not parties to the mediation.
content.glance: Section 6 lists disputes that are not fit for mediation, including disputes expressly barred and those affecting rights of third parties who are not parties to the mediation.
content.study: Not every dispute can be mediated. Section 6 excludes matters that the Act or other law bars from mediation, and disputes that affect the rights of third parties who have not consented. Criminal prosecutions and matters requiring a court declaration of status are typical exclusions.
